market_outlook.short_term: Bullish bias into Trump-Xi summit with Dow +450 momentum; oil weakness supports risk appetite. But diesel inflation and Fed hawkishness cap upside. Expect volatility around summit outcome. Bank stocks remain under pressure. Crypto (BTC, Hyperliquid) provides alternative momentum.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact but valuation compression creates selective opportunities. Trade truce extension supports global growth. Diesel/energy inflation is the primary macro risk to watch. IPO pipeline (Anthropic, Westinghouse) signals capital market confidence. Political polarization adds tail risk through 2026 midterms.
